title: Fooling LLM Safety Guards into Judging the Wrong Text
abstract: arXiv:2610.31695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety guards check content before an LLM application acts on it, and most paste that content into a plain-text prompt. Content that imitates the prompt can append a second task, and the guard answers that one instead. We call this target rebinding. Our explanation is that the guard grades the last complete task in its input, here a harmless decoy, so the harmful request goes through unchanged. In a pre-registered test, an appended forged query and decoy clear all 75 held-out AdvBench requests that Shieldstral-1.0-3B flags. The guard is not persuaded: a directive to ignore the text above clears none of them, and in a follow-up run a harmful decoy stops the attack. On our GuardRebind benchmark, each of five guards has an attack family, chosen per guard, that clears at least 93% of its flagged items. Rebinding explains this best on Shieldstral and gpt-oss-safeguard; on ShieldGemma and Llama Guard 3, generic evasion and trailing text resp

translated_title: 欺骗大语言模型安全防护机制对错误的文本进行判断
translated_abstract: 在LLM应用程序对内容采取行动之前，安全防护机制会先检查内容，而大多数防护机制会将该内容直接粘贴到纯文本提示词中。模仿提示词格式的内容可以附加第二个任务，防护机制反而会去回答那个任务。我们将这一现象称为“目标重绑定”。我们的解释是：防护机制评判的是其输入中最后一个完整的任务（此处为无害的诱饵），因此有害请求得以原封不动地通过。在一项预注册测试中，附加的伪造查询和诱饵成功绕过了Shieldstral-1.0-3B标记的全部75个保留AdvBench有害请求。防护机制并非被说服："忽略上述文本”的指令无法绕过其中任何一个请求，且在后续运行中，有害的诱饵反而会阻止攻击。在我们的GuardRebind基准测试中，五种防护机制中的每一种都有一个（针对各防护机制选择的）攻击家族，能够绕过至少93%的被其标记的项目。目标重绑定对Shieldstral和gpt-oss-safeguard的解释效果最好；而对于ShieldGemma和Llama Guard 3，通用规避和尾部文本策略分别……
tldr: 论文提出“目标重绑定”攻击方法——通过附加伪造查询和无害诱饵，利用安全防护机制只评判输入中最后一个完整任务的特性，使有害内容绕过审查，在GuardRebind基准上对五种防护机制的绕过率均超过93%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "target rebinding" attack that exploits LLM safety guards' tendency to judge the last complete task in their input by appending forged queries and harmless decoys, enabling harmful requests to bypass detection with over 93% success rates against five different guards on the GuardRebind benchmark.
